lead: A bench chained as `$inputs[$total % N]` can pick the same input every round, and it still prints a plausible total.
body: When the first input's measured size is a multiple of `N`, the index never moves: `benches/members/core/Html/escape.nvs` reads `"Tom & Jerry"` (15 escaped characters) on every one of its rounds, so its figure is one input's figure. Chain on `($total + $i) % N` and check the printed total differs from `rounds × first size`.
